title: Great use
text:
Great use. I purchased this for a friend who flies on occasion and has a bad back. She reports this pillow was great. She says she used it on behind her neck and then, deflated a bit and used at her lumbar. Both were useful. She also reports that it was easy to blow up and then to deflate and store. She also says the storage bag was very handy to roll up and place the pillow in when not in use. It takes up the space of a rolled up washcloth. All in all an awesome gift I would say.
UPDATE: 7/20/2015... My friend uses this pillow every single day... it's not just for "travel" in her mind. She had an accident some 30 years ago and has had back issues ever since. She says that this pillow is so handy she doesn't go literally anywhere without it. I added a star to make it a perfect 5. I'm even wondering if I should order one for myself!
